description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/goal-target-inference.ts the inferred target shapes are capped by three separate .slice(0, 3) calls. Introduce a single module-level constant MAX_TARGET_SHAPES = 3 and use it at all three call sites instead of the repeated literal. Behaviour must be unchanged; this only names the bound in one place. Nonce fix-cap-9b7e.
